questions.stem: A 24-Year-old primigravida with 38 weeks of gestation presents with pain abdomen, backache, contractions, and show. She is a case of type I DM on treatment and well-controlled blood sugar levels. Her previous lab investigations and use are normal. On examination, P-80/min, BP-120/88mmHg, RR-13/min, afebrile, saturation normal, pallor +. Abdominal examination shows fundus just below xiphisternum, vertical lie, cephalic presentation, head engaged, FHR-140/min, contractions 5/10mins. PV examination shows cervix soft, effaced, dilated-7cm, 1.5cm length, head at station +1, membranes absent. NST was normal. The labor was monitored, and after the delivery of the head, the progress of labor wasn't seen. The recoil of the head back against the perineum was seen.
